examples_chunks_list: Python is a high-level programming language. It is widely used for web development, data science, machine learning, automation, and scripting.
RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. RAG allows an LLM to retrieve information from an external knowledge source before generating an answer.
Vector databases store numerical representations called embeddings. They allow applications to search for semantically similar pieces of information.
Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence. Where systems learn patterns from data and use those patterns to make predictions or decisions.
